user.title: Docker Compose Manager
user.description: Point this integration at your Compose stacks root. Each immediate subfolder containing a docker-compose.yml/compose.yaml is discovered as one stack.

data.docker_host: Docker host address (e.g. tcp://127.0.0.1:2375 for docker-socket-proxy, or unix:///var/run/docker.sock)
data.sidecar_container: Sidecar container name (runs docker compose commands)

error.stacks_root_not_found: That path does not exist or is not a directory.
error.invalid_docker_host: Docker host address must start with tcp:// or unix://.
error.no_stacks_found: No stacks found under that path (no subfolder with a docker-compose.yml/compose.yaml).
error.discovery_failed: Stack discovery failed. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This stacks root is already configured.
